intro.text:
Page Context API Demo

This page demonstrates how to check Instance Type (Author/Renderer/Standalone) and Page Mode (Edit/Preview) using the PageContext API.

Open this page on both Author (8082) and Renderer (8083) to see the differences.

htl-section.text:
1. HTL Usage (Recommended)

The HTL version uses data-sly-use.ctx="org.apache.sling.cms.PageContext" directly in the template:

model-section.text:
2. Sling Model Usage

The Sling Model version uses a model (PageContextDemoModel) that injects PageContext:

jsp-section.text:
3. JSP Usage (Legacy)

The JSP version uses ${slingPageContext} variable available from global.jsp:

usage-notes.text:
Usage Notes

Instance Types

TypeDescriptionPort
AUTHORContent authoring instance8082
RENDERERContent delivery/publish instance8083
STANDALONESingle instance for both8080

Page Modes

ModeDescription
EDITPage is being edited in CMS editor
PREVIEWPage is being previewed (no edit controls)

Quick Reference

// HTL (Recommended)
<sly data-sly-use.ctx="org.apache.sling.cms.PageContext">
  <sly data-sly-test="${ctx.editMode}">Edit Mode</sly>
  <sly data-sly-test="${ctx.author}">Author Instance</sly>
</sly>

// Sling Model
@Self
private PageContext pageContext;
pageContext.isEditMode();
pageContext.isAuthor();

// JSP (via global.jsp)
<c:if test="${slingPageContext.editMode}">Edit Mode</c:if>
<c:if test="${slingPageContext.author}">Author Instance</c:if>

footer.text: This page demonstrates the PageContext API in Apache Sling CMS. Compare results on Author (8082) vs Renderer (8083).
